LanguageData.TrapBear.label: bear trap
LanguageData.TrapBear.description: A trap that closes its spiky teeth on the victims legs, feet and hands and stuns them for a moderate amount of time.
LanguageData.TrapBodyCrusher.label: body crusher trap
LanguageData.TrapBodyCrusher.description: A trap that closes its two weights on the victims body and head.
LanguageData.TrapBodySlicer.label: body slicer trap
LanguageData.TrapBodySlicer.description: A trap that closes its two blades on the victims body.
LanguageData.TrapCaltrops.label: caltrops trap
LanguageData.TrapCaltrops.description: A set of small caltrops that can poke and penetrate the victims legs, feet or hands and slow them down. It triggers for every other victim.
LanguageData.TrapFreezePad.label: freeze pad trap
LanguageData.TrapFreezePad.description: A freeze pad that can freeze the victims legs, feet or hands.
LanguageData.TrapHeatPad.label: heat pad trap
LanguageData.TrapHeatPad.description: A heat pad that can burn the victims legs, feet or hands and has a chance to set them on fire.
LanguageData.TrapSaws.label: saws trap
LanguageData.TrapSaws.description: A set of saws that can severely damage the top part of the victim.
LanguageData.TrapSpikes.label: spikes trap
LanguageData.TrapSpikes.description: A set of poison spikes that can inflict damage on the victims legs, feet or hands. It triggers for every other victim.
